# CI/CD Status Badges

Add these badges to your main README.md to display build and security status:

```markdown
## Status

![CI/CD Pipeline](https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/YOUR_REPO/workflows/CI%2FCD%20Pipeline/badge.svg)
![Security Scan](https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/YOUR_REPO/workflows/Security%20Scan/badge.svg)
![Pull Request Checks](https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/YOUR_REPO/workflows/Pull%20Request%20Checks/badge.svg)

[![Coverage](https://img.shields.io/badge/coverage-60%25-yellow.svg)](build/reports/jacoco/test/html/index.html)
[![SpotBugs](https://img.shields.io/badge/spotbugs-passing-brightgreen.svg)](build/reports/spotbugs/)
```

Replace `YOUR_USERNAME` and `YOUR_REPO` with your actual GitHub repository details.

## Additional Badges

You can also add:

```markdown
[![Java Version](https://img.shields.io/badge/Java-17-blue.svg)](https://openjdk.org/)
[![Spring Boot](https://img.shields.io/badge/Spring%20Boot-3.3.4-green.svg)](https://spring.io/projects/spring-boot)
[![Angular](https://img.shields.io/badge/Angular-19-red.svg)](https://angular.io/)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
```
